subject: Post-call: SLO-aware routing & cost options
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma@novacare.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 14:02:17 -0700
Subject: Post-call: SLO-aware routing & cost options

Thanks again for the call earlier, Emma — good discussion. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get you a tight pilot + cost estimate:

Recap (what I heard)
- Primary UI search / chat: low-latency requirement, target P95 ~300ms.
- Background ranking and batch enrichment: latency tolerant (seconds), high throughput.
- Typical day today: ~120k tokens/day; weekly spikes up to ~1.1M tokens.
- Target unit econ you mentioned on call: roughly $10 per 1M tokens (open to range).

High-level options we discussed
- Streaming / hot path: provides the lowest tail latency for UI calls; cost ~1.8x baseline per token relative to a fully batched path.
- Batched endpoints: runs cheaper (we're seeing ~0.6x per-token unit cost) but add latency and require request aggregation.
- Multi-tier routing: keep a small hot pool for interactive traffic, route lower priority/async work to batched workers or cold model variants.
- Dedicated baseline + hosted burst: reserved capacity for predictable baseline, autoscaled hosted capacity for unpredictable spikes.

Immediate asks / deliverables
1) Can you share a sample 7-day traffic profile (tokens by minute/hour) — that will let us build a realistic cost simulation (attached: pilot_scope.xlsx has the columns we need).
2) Confirm the acceptable latency SLOs for the three classes (interactive, nearline, batch).
3) Confirm an initial budget range for a 30-day pilot (you mentioned mid-four-figure monthly budget during the call).

Attachment: pilot_scope.xlsx (sheet: traffic_profile template)

Proposed next steps
- You send traffic CSV + confirm SLOs and budget range.
- We run a 48-hour cost/latency simulation and return a recommended routing + pricing band (with example $/1M numbers for streaming vs batch).
- If that looks good, pilot kickoff (30 days) to validate under live load.

I'll put a short estimate together once we get the traffic sample. If it's easier, propose a 30-minute follow-up next week to walk through the pilot sheet together — I can be available Wed/Thu afternoon PT.

— Mateo
Mateo Alvarez | Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
D: +1 415-555-0192 | mateo_alvarez@redwood.com

Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 14:37:49 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: SLO-aware routing & cost options

Thanks Mateo — appreciate the clear recap. Confirming the numbers and a few answers inline:

- Volume: our normal baseline is ~120k tokens/day. We do scheduled weekly campaigns (Mon mornings) that can get us to ~1.1M tokens for a 3–6 hour burst.
- SLOs: interactive UI (P95) target 300ms; nearline features (autosuggestions) OK at 800ms; batch jobs (daily enrichment) can be minutes.
- Budget: for a 30-day pilot we can commit to $3k–$12k depending on the proposal (we want to see unit econ and a clear path to <$12 per 1M tokens at scale).
- Compliance: we will likely need SOC2 evidence before an enterprise purchase — is Redwood SOC2 Type II? If not, what controls can we provide for the pilot?

I attached a 7-day sample token profile (novacare-traffic.csv) with per-minute counts for our main endpoints.

Next: please send a cost simulation and a concise pilot plan (timeboxed tasks + acceptance criteria). We can do a follow-up on Thu 11am PT if that works.

— Emma
Emma Li
Head of Product, Novacare AI
emma@novacare.ai | +1 212-555-0147
Attachment: novacare-traffic.csv (CSV, 7 days, per-minute token counts)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 09:10:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: SLO-aware routing & cost options

Quick internal notes / recommended approach before we send the formal estimate:

1) Tiering recommendation (short):
- Hot / streaming pool: sized for steady interactive QPS (keep P95 ~200–350ms) — good for chat/search.
- Warm / micro-batches: for suggestions that can tolerate 500–800ms, use short-window batching (200–500ms aggregation).
- Cold / scheduled batch: for daily enrichments, use large batch jobs overnight at lower-cost model variants.

2) Unit econ examples (rough, for the customer's target $10 / 1M):
- Baseline (fully batched) estimate: ~0.6x -> effective $6 / 1M tokens.
- Hot streaming path: ~1.8x -> effective $18 / 1M tokens.
- Mixed routing (recommended): allocate ~15% of tokens to hot streaming and 85% to batching for their profile -> blended ~$8.4 / 1M tokens.

3) Dedicated vs Hosted mix:
- Suggest recommending a small Dedicated baseline commit to reduce unit cost on predictable tokens (e.g., reserve for 50–100k tokens/day equivalent) and rely on hosted burst for campaign spikes.

4) Pilot sizing suggestion:
- 30-day pilot, target 500k tokens/day equivalent (mix to reflect their CSV). Acceptance: validate P95 at interactive endpoints and confirm blended unit econ within target band.

I'm attaching a quick calc we can use to fill the proposal template (pricing_quickcalc.csv). I also added notes about compliance — we can offer an isolated logging bucket and a tight data-retention window for pilot customers who need lighter controls. For full enterprise we'll surface the SOC2 report.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole | Sr. Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
Attachment: pricing_quickcalc.csv
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>

Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 09:24:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: SLO-aware routing & cost options

Emma — thanks for the traffic file and budget clarity. We ran a quick simulation based on your CSV and Marissa's mixing assumptions. High level summary below; full breakdown attached (redwood-pricing-v2.pdf).

Simulation highlights (30-day view, illustrative)
- Baseline 120k/day steady + 1x weekly 3-hour spike to 1.1M -> blended tokens ~4.2M/month.
- Option A (Streaming-first): 40% hot, 60% batch -> blended cost ~$12.6 / 1M -> est. $53/month (note: streaming-heavy).
- Option B (Mixed recommended): 15% hot, 85% batch -> blended cost ~$8.4 / 1M -> est. $35/month.
- Sensitivity: If hot proportion rises above 30% cost moves above their $12 target.

Compliance note: Redwood can provide our SOC2 Type II report for procurement review; for the pilot we will use a dedicated logging bucket and an HMAC key rotation cadence to limit exposure.

Proposed next steps
1) Sign the pilot SOW (DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/contract/DEAL-9081).
2) Pilot kickoff call: Thu 27 May, 11:00 AM PT (calendar invite attached).
3) We will instrument a short 48-hour synthetic run before turning on live traffic to validate routing rules.

If that plan looks good I can send the SOW and a short statement of work tonight. Thu 11am PT works on our side for the follow-up.

— Mateo
Mateo Alvarez | Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-pricing-v2.pdf
